verdict.rationale: Rippling's payroll docs state it automatically calculates payroll taxes and files them with the correct federal, state, and local agencies at the right time, and global payroll claims instant calculation and filing worldwide. This covers the core of the story at all three jurisdictional levels. missing for 10: explicit documentation of tax remittance/payment (only implied by 'file them'), in-depth first-party docs beyond marketing copy, independent or hands-on corroboration of tax filing accuracy.
